observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox console with a matching controller resting on top.
The console has a textured black front panel with diagonal ribbing.
The controller is black with standard Xbox buttons (A, B, X, Y) and analog sticks.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a side angle, revealing the left side with a visible disc drive slot and a small logo (possibly PlayStation or another brand) on the left.
The console appears to be a standard Xbox model, likely the original Xbox 360 or Xbox One, but the side view does not clearly show the model name.
The console has visible scratches and scuffs, especially on the left side in photo 1.
The controller shows some wear, including minor scratches and possible dirt.
No games or discs are visible in either photo.
The seller claims it includes games and one controller, but no games or discs are shown.

claims.claim: Uk used Xbox console with games and one controller including FC, GTA, Mk
claims.evidence: No games or discs are visible in the photos. The controller is present, but no games are shown. The claim about FC, GTA, Mk is unverifiable_remote as these are not shown or identifiable.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Games and discs may not be included or may be damaged
risks.proof: Photos of the games and discs, or a video showing them being inserted and played.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine Xbox
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label or serial number on the console, or a video showing the console's system information screen.

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back showing the model, serial or service tag.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Photos of the included games and discs.
Video of the controller connecting and functioning.
Clear photo of the model label or serial number on the console.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
